content: The division of a marital home and land was contested on the grounds that personal pre-marital funds were used for the acquisition. The Court clarified that personal status under Art. 179 CC does not arise solely because an asset was purchased with personal money; it requires a formal exchange (permuta) or a declaration that the purchase is funded by the sale of specific personal assets. In cases of physical indivisibility where properties are assigned to one spouse to minimize cash settlements, the judge may establish necessary easements, such as a right of way or parking, to ensure the functional utility of the newly formed autonomous units.
